thread:
priyanka: Heads-up — ACME Corp just sent their security questionnaire. Big asks around RBAC scopes, KMS BYOK, and 13-month audit log retention. Can we do a quick sync? :calendar:

maria: I'm available. Main constraints: RBAC currently has roles {admin, infra, dev, ops}. We can add scoped roles but need to update token-checker and the permissions matrix. For audit logs we have 12 months in GCS by default. 13 months is odd but doable with a lifecycle policy. :ok_hand:

sam: KMS: we support customer-managed keys via envelope encryption. We use a root KEK in KMS and rotate data keys daily. BYOK flow requires a cert exchange + HSM attestation. I'll link the BYOK diagram: https://internal/redwood/docs/kms/byok

jordan: vuln triage note: flagged CVE-2025-1147 in libproto. Patch in staging, PR #4281. Short mitigation: WAF sig + ipblock rule until patch deploys.

priyanka: They also asked about vuln SLAs and incident response. Want commit windows for critical/high/medium, and a brief runbook for containment.

maria: Draft responses: RBAC - propose new "auditor" role with read-only access to logs/metrics and limited query access. Schema migration in auth-service + small UI change. Estimate 3 business days to ship to prod (feature flagged).

sam: Audit logging draft: logs are stored in GCS (projects/redwood-logs, region=us-central1) with 12mo default retention. We can add a 13mo lifecycle rule or export to customer S3 for longer retention. Export pipeline example: `gcloud logging sinks create acme-export storage.googleapis.com/gs-bucket --log-filter="resource.type=\"redwood_service\""`

sam: KMS draft text for questionnaire: "Redwood supports customer-owned keys (BYOK) via envelope encryption. Customers provision keys in their KMS/HSM, Redwood stores encrypted data encryption keys (DEKs) and cannot access plaintext. Key rotation and usage audit logs are available to customers via their KMS." Sample config:
```
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_alias: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
  rotation_days: 30
```

securitybot: Incident runbook template: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/incident-response. Suggested SLAs: ack within 15m, mitigation steps for critical within 2h, full remediation/patch in 72h. Attach postmortem template. :page_facing_up:

ops-oncall: For the call I'll bring system metrics (QPS, tail latency) + last 3 deploy hashes. Recommend offering a timed export (monthly) if they want >13mo retention. Also suggest we propose a read-only IAM role mapping for their security team.

priyanka: Great. Action items before Tue 10am call with ACME: @maria open RBAC PR + permissions matrix, @sam update BYOK doc + sample config and attach diagram, @jordan finish patch + add mitigations to runbook, @ops-oncall prepare metrics + deploy info. I'll compile into a single call deck. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll open the PR today and include migration notes and test plan.

sam: Updating docs now, will post link in this thread when ready.

jordan: Patch scheduled for tonight's deploy window; will update when merged and share CVE tracker link.

priyanka: Thanks team — I'll assemble and share the draft deck by EOD Monday for review.
